description: Read the project's source for the mistakes the inspector's Babel plugin finds while Metro builds it, without running the app (keyframer-inspect lint): worklet crashes (a worklet using a value declared after it, or calling a JS function on the UI thread; severity crash, always listed) and motion mistakes that do not crash (a descending interpolate range, scheduleOnRN on every frame, a spring config without mass, a shared value read while rendering, deprecated APIs…; severity error, warning or info). Over the project root this server was started with, or files and folders inside it; node_modules, build output and native folders are skipped. Returns each finding as file:line, severity, rule, message and its fix, most severe first. No app needs to be connected. React Native (Reanimated, worklets, Gesture Handler) only.

limit.description: Findings listed at most, most severe first. Default 50, at most 500.

paths.description: Files or folders inside the project root, relative to it. Default: all of it.

severity.description: The least severe motion finding listed. Default info (all). Worklet crashes are always listed.

name: lint_project
